title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
description: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

title: David Walliams accused of sexual misconduct after losing injunction bid
description: ITN and the Guardian allege the comedian preyed on teenage girls and young women. He has denied all allegations.

title: Watch: What we know about the allegations against Walliams
description: The author and comedian recently lost a court battle trying to block publication of the allegations.

title: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up
description: The BBC gains rare access to a specialist drone unit defending the eastern city of Slovyansk from heavy Russian fire.

title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle detained for allegedly cutting off ankle monitor, officials say
description: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

title: Train attack driver's '10 seconds' to change line
description: Andrew Johnson tells jurors he heard over the intercom "'there's a knifeman stabbing people'".

title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
description: The Ritz hotel in Paris, which is still owned by the Al Fayed family, is one of the properties searched by police.

title: Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair
description: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water  jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
description: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.
